title: Shell Task Transcript Index Record
description: One append-only line of tasks/index.jsonl, written when a supervised task reaches a terminal status. Planned contract for keryx-shell-task-transcripts (v1.0.0). Metadata only: transcript CONTENT is never duplicated here (D-12, D-14).

taskId.description: The registry's session-scoped id (task-<n>-<pid>), as issued by the shipped registry.

command.description: REDACTED command text — redactSensitiveText(info.command), never the registry's raw BackgroundJobInfo.command (src/harness/tool/builtin/background-job-registry.ts:62). A command line routinely carries a credential.

endedAt.description: Absent when the session died before the task reached a terminal status; see footerPresent.

status.description: Mirrors the shipped task statuses. Absent means the outcome is UNKNOWN (no footer was written) — it is never reported as success (D-11 of this package's specification §5.1).

killReason.description: The shipped KillReason union (background-job-registry.ts:56). Present only when status is killed.

file.description: Transcript filename RELATIVE to the tasks/ directory (e.g. task-3-48211.log). Never an absolute path: this record is operator-facing and must not become a path source for anything model-facing (D-11).

indexFile.description: Flush-map filename relative to tasks/ (e.g. task-3-48211.idx.jsonl): lines of { raw, file, bytes } mapping raw stream offsets to file offsets, which is what makes a flush-aligned ranged read possible (D-10).

rawBytes.description: Bytes the command emitted, before masking. Differs from bytesWritten because masks are fixed-width (src/security/redact.ts:23-25).

bytesWritten.description: Bytes actually written to the transcript, after redaction.

maskedSpans.description: How many spans were masked on the way to disk. An operator signal, not a guarantee: the detector floor is deterministic regex only (src/security/redact.ts:121-127), so 0 does not mean the output held no secret.

truncated.description: Why the transcript is incomplete, when it is. Absent means nothing was dropped by the sink. 'task-cap' is the per-task byte cap; 'io-error' is a sink queue that could not drain, which drops bytes rather than stalling or killing the task (PRD N2).

footerPresent.description: Whether the closing footer was written. false means the session died mid-task; every reader must report the outcome as unknown rather than as a success, mirroring the retention stamp's started-vs-completed split (src/retention/auto-sweep.ts:103-113).

keyBlockMasked.description: An unterminated PRIVATE KEY block was seen and the sink masked from the marker onward (specification §5.2, step 6). Recorded because a fail-closed mask is a fact an operator may need to explain a truncated-looking transcript.
